halt production: The factory had to halt production for two weeks after the earthquake damaged several of its machines.
地震損壞了數台機器之後，工廠不得不停產兩週。
halt the spread: Wearing masks and washing hands helped halt the spread of the virus in many crowded cities.
戴口罩和洗手幫助許多擁擠的城市阻止病毒蔓延。
come to a halt: The train suddenly came to a halt in the middle of the tunnel, and passengers waited nervously for news.
火車突然在隧道中間停下，乘客們緊張地等待消息。
bring to a halt: Heavy snow can bring to a halt almost all traffic in the mountains, leaving drivers stuck for hours.
大雪可能使山區幾乎所有交通停止，讓駕駛人受困好幾個小時。
call a halt to: The principal decided to call a halt to the noisy party because it was already past ten o'clock.
因為已經超過十點，校長決定叫停那場吵鬧的派對。
hammer out an agreement: After hours of discussion, the two companies finally managed to hammer out an agreement that satisfied both sides.
經過好幾個小時的討論，兩家公司終於敲定了一份讓雙方都滿意的協議。
hammer home a point: The coach likes to hammer home a point by repeating it at every practice until everyone remembers it.
教練喜歡在每次練習時重複同一件事，反覆強調一個重點，直到大家都記住。
hammer the opponent: Our basketball team hammered the opponent in the final, winning the championship by more than forty points.
我們的籃球隊在決賽中痛擊對手，以超過四十分的差距贏得冠軍。
hammer away at: Although the math problem was hard, Ken kept hammering away at it until he found the answer late at night.
雖然那道數學題很難，阿肯仍不斷努力解題，直到深夜才找出答案。
hamper progress: Constant arguments among team members can seriously hamper progress on a group project and waste everyone's time.
組員之間不斷爭吵會嚴重阻礙小組報告的進展，浪費大家的時間。
hamper rescue efforts: Falling rocks and heavy rain continued to hamper rescue efforts after the landslide buried several houses.
土石流掩埋數棟房屋後，落石和大雨持續妨礙救援工作。
hampered by bad weather: The search for the missing hikers was hampered by bad weather, because strong winds kept the helicopters on the ground.
搜尋失蹤登山客的行動受壞天氣阻礙，因為強風使直升機無法起飛。
handle pressure: Top athletes must learn how to handle pressure when thousands of fans are watching them during important games.
頂尖運動員必須學會在重要比賽中被數千名球迷注視時如何應付壓力。
handle a situation: The flight attendant stayed calm and knew exactly how to handle a situation when a passenger suddenly fainted.
當一名乘客突然昏倒時，空服員保持冷靜，完全知道該如何處理情況。
handle complaints: Part of my sister's job at the hotel is to handle complaints from guests who are unhappy with their rooms.
我姊姊在飯店的部分工作就是處理對房間不滿意的客人的客訴。
handle with care: The box was marked "Handle with care" because it contained my grandmother's old glass dishes.
箱子上標示著「小心輕放」，因為裡面裝著祖母的舊玻璃盤子。
handle the ball: In soccer, only the goalkeeper may handle the ball, and other players who touch it with their hands commit a foul.
在足球比賽中，只有守門員可以用手碰球，其他球員用手觸球就是犯規（手球）。
hang on: Hang on a second, please; I need to find a pen before you tell me your phone number.
請等一下；在你告訴我你的電話號碼之前，我需要找支筆。
hang out with friends: On Friday nights, I like to hang out with friends at the night market, eating snacks and chatting for hours.
星期五晚上，我喜歡和朋友混在夜市，吃小吃、聊上好幾個小時。
hang in there: I know final exams are stressful, but hang in there; summer vacation is only two weeks away.
我知道期末考壓力很大，但撐住；暑假只剩兩週了。
hang up: Please don't hang up the phone yet; I still need to give you my new address.
請先別掛電話；我還需要給你我的新地址。
hang over one's head: The unfinished science report continued to hang over my head all weekend, so I couldn't relax at all.
那份沒寫完的自然報告整個週末一直懸在我心頭，讓我完全無法放鬆。
get the hang of: Riding a bike seemed impossible at first, but after a few days of practice I began to get the hang of it.
騎腳踏車起初似乎不可能，但練習幾天後我開始掌握訣竅了。
harbor a grudge: Even though they made up years ago, he still seems to harbor a grudge against his brother for breaking his guitar.
雖然他們幾年前就和好了，他似乎仍因哥哥弄壞他的吉他而懷恨在心。
harbor suspicions: Although she smiled politely, she continued to harbor suspicions in her heart that her new neighbor was lying.
雖然她禮貌地微笑，她心裡仍心存懷疑，覺得新鄰居在說謊。
harbor a criminal: The man was arrested because he agreed to harbor a criminal in his apartment while the police searched the city.
那名男子被捕，因為他在警方搜索全市時答應窩藏一名罪犯在他的公寓裡。
harbor doubts: Many voters still harbor doubts about whether the mayor can really keep all the promises he made.
許多選民仍心存疑慮，不確定市長是否真的能實現他所有的承諾。
harbor ambitions: Ever since she was a little girl, Lily has harbored ambitions of becoming a famous fashion designer in Paris.
莉莉從小就懷抱野心，想成為巴黎知名的時裝設計師。
harbor hopes: The family still harbor hopes that their lost dog will find its way home after missing for three days.
這家人仍懷抱希望，盼望失蹤三天的狗能自己找到路回家。
